title: Contract Senior DevOps & GCP Cloud Architect
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior DevOps & Cloud Architect for a contract engagement to design, build, automate, and optimize cloud-native infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The ideal consultant will bring 12+ years of hands-on experience across the complete DevOps lifecycle, including cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), security, observability, and production operations. You will work closely with startups, growing businesses, and enterprise organizations to deliver scalable, secure, highly available, and cost-efficient cloud solutions.

This contract role is best suited for a results-driven cloud professional who can independently lead infrastructure initiatives, modernize platforms, implement automation, and drive operational excellence in production environments.

Key Responsibilities
Design and implement scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure on GCP.
Lead cloud migration, modernization, and transformation initiatives.
Architect and implement production-grade Kubernetes platforms using GKE.
Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform.
Design, develop, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to accelerate application delivery.
Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment processes, and operational workflows.
Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions.
Establish DevSecOps practices across infrastructure and application delivery pipelines.
Optimize cloud costs, system performance, and resource utilization.
Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive reliability improvements.
Design disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability architectures.
Collaborate with application, security, and infrastructure teams to improve platform reliability and operational efficiency.
Mentor engineering teams on DevOps best practices, automation, and cloud-native technologies.

Required Experience
Minimum 12+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
Proven experience designing and supporting production-scale cloud environments.
Strong background in cloud architecture, automation, and infrastructure modernization.
Experience supporting both startup and enterprise-scale platforms.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex cloud and DevOps initiatives independently.

Technical Skills
Cloud Platform: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); Multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud architecture; Cloud migration and modernization; Infrastructure scaling and optimization; Cost optimization and governance; High availability and disaster recovery planning
Containerization & Kubernetes: Kubernetes (GKE); Docker and containerized workloads; Kubernetes security and policy management; Cluster auto-scaling and optimization; Service mesh and ingress management; Production-grade Kubernetes operations; Performance tuning and troubleshooting
Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Terraform; Infrastructure provisioning and automation; Environment standardization; Configuration management; Infrastructure lifecycle management
CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions; GitLab CI/CD; Deployment automation; Release engineering; Pipeline optimization and governance; Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
Monitoring, Logging & Observability: Prometheus; Grafana; Google Cloud Operations Suite; Alerting and incident management; Centralized logging; Performance monitoring and troubleshooting; Observability platform implementation
Security & DevSecOps: IAM and RBAC implementation; Secrets management; Security hardening; Vulnerability scanning and remediation; WAF and network security; Policy enforcement using Kyverno; Compliance-focused infrastructure design; Secure CI/CD pipeline implementation; Zero-downtime deployment strategies
Automation & Scripting: Python scripting; Workflow automation; Cron jobs and task automation; Reliability engineering; Process optimization
Networking & Infrastructure: VPC and network architecture; Load balancers and ingress controllers; DNS and CDN configuration; VPN and secure connectivity; Cloud networking and routing; Infrastructure optimization and scalability

Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading cloud transformation and modernization projects.
Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles.
Experience building self-service platform engineering capabilities.
Deep expertise in Kubernetes and cloud-native ecosystems.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to mentor engineering teams and establish DevOps best practices.
Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments.

What Success Looks Like
Secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure.
Highly automated deployment and operational workflows.
Reliable and optimized Kubernetes platforms.
Improved application performance and platform availability.
Reduced operational overhead through Infrastructure as Code and automation.
Strong observability and incident response processes.
Optimized cloud spend without compromising performance or reliability.
Improved security posture and compliance readiness.

Contract Details
Position: Contract Senior DevOps & Cloud Architect (GCP & Kubernetes)
Employment Type: Contract
Location: Remote / Hybrid
Experience Required: 12+ Years
Domain: DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Platform Engineering, SRE, DevSecOps

Ideal Candidate
A seasoned GCP-focused DevOps & Cloud Architect with extensive experience designing, automating, securing, and optimizing cloud-native platforms. The successful consultant will have a proven track record of delivering production-grade infrastructure, Kubernetes solutions, CI/CD automation, cloud cost optimization, observability, and reliability improvements across complex enterprise and startup environments.
